evidence.reason: The dependency scan enumerates [Unit]/unit-reference directives but omits `PropagatesStopTo=` and its inverse `StopPropagatedFrom=`, both recognized by systemd v257 (the version cited in this file). A co-installed unit with `PropagatesStopTo=crq-tick.service` can stop the selected service when that co-installed unit stops, but the current regex will not detect the relationship, allowing an incorrect `supported=True` discovery result. This is a code-correctness gap in the existing scan, not a new requirement.
